text: (AC-01) The loan product catalog offers at least 3 products — Personal, Vehicle and Education — each with its own rule set read from a versioned policy file.
label: FR-1

text: (AC-02) A customer can apply for a loan for a chosen product, and a required-document checklist specific to that product is generated.
label: FR-2

text: (AC-03) A credit-scoring stub returns a deterministic score from age, income and credit-history flags.
label: FR-3

text: (AC-04) Underwriting returns AUTO_APPROVE, AUTO_REJECT or MANUAL_REVIEW with reason codes referenced from the active policy version, which is the latest approved version at the time of submission.
label: FR-4

text: (AC-05) An application whose income is below the minimum threshold of the selected product fails with PolicyViolationException, raised by the rule engine and persisted as AUTO_REJECT with a reason code.
label: FR-5

text: (AC-06) An underwriter can mark each submitted document VERIFIED or REJECTED, with a reason, from a document-verification queue.
label: FR-6

text: (AC-07) On approval, the repayment schedule is generated using the EMI formula, and the sum of principal and interest equals total payable.
label: FR-7

text: (AC-08) Disbursement records the released amount and the funding source (stubbed).
label: FR-8

text: (AC-09) Posting a repayment reduces outstanding principal and recalculates the bucket (CURRENT, DPD-30, DPD-60, DPD-90, NPA).
label: FR-9

text: (AC-10) An admin can list applications, filter them by status and product, and override an AUTO_REJECT with a comment and reason code; the override is audited.
label: FR-10

text: (D-01) A customer can track an application: its status, missing documents, decision and reason codes.
label: FR-11

text: (D-02) A customer can view the repayment schedule of their loan, post a repayment, and see the updated outstanding principal and bucket.
label: FR-12

text: (D-03) An underwriter can open an application queue of applications awaiting work.
label: FR-13

text: (D-04) An underwriter can approve or reject an application in MANUAL_REVIEW with a reason, and the action is audited with user ID and timestamp.
label: FR-14

text: (D-05) An underwriter can override an AUTO_REJECT with a comment and reason code, and the override is audited with user ID and timestamp.
label: FR-15

text: (D-06) A policy editor can edit thresholds (income, age, score, tenure, rate) per product without a code change, producing a new versioned policy file that an admin approves before it becomes active.
label: FR-16

text: (D-07) An admin can open a portfolio dashboard showing applications and active loans by product, the NPA bucket and total overdue.
label: FR-17

text: (D-08) An end-of-day job recalculates the delinquency bucket of every active loan as of a given date.
label: FR-18

text: (D-09) No money value (principal, interest, EMI) is held, stored or computed as a floating-point number anywhere in the system.
label: FR-19

text: (D-10) A health endpoint is available without authentication and reports that the system is ready.
label: FR-20

text: Money (principal, interest, EMI) is computed in fixed-point (BigDecimal / decimal), rounded half-up to 2 decimal places — never floating-point.
label: NFR-01

text: Approved policy versions and generated repayment schedules are append-only — no update or delete: 0 permitted modifications, enforced in application code and by database triggers.
label: NFR-02

text: Synthetic identifiers (PAN, Aadhaar) and salary documents are never written to logs: 0 occurrences of an identifier value or document filename in captured logs.
label: NFR-03

text: Authentication boundary enforced at controller layer on 100% of routes except login and health; underwriter actions are audited with user ID and timestamp.
label: NFR-04

text: Database migrations and policy migrations are append-only: 0 edits to an applied migration or approved policy file, checked by SHA-256 at startup.
label: NFR-05

text: Structured JSON logs, one line per request, with a request correlation ID on 100% of lines.
label: NFR-06

text: Health endpoint returns 200 within 1 second of a successful startup.
label: NFR-07

text: Architecture rules enforced as automated tests (e.g., policy version cannot be mutated; EMI invariant principal × rate × tenure equation holds): at least 3 structural tests, run on every pull request.
label: NFR-08
